svg.title: Forge UGC — Avatar Lab
svg.desc: Measured native vector reconstruction of the newly generated Avatar Lab screen. Illustrated media are individually traced sample placeholders; labels and controls remain editable. Catalog prices use R$ rather than Forge tokens. Card controls explicitly use visit bookmarks and View in Roblox. Sample names, prices and outfit are live-data placeholders.
svg.text: Build a look that feels like you.
